name: mark-pick
title: Mark pick
description: A recognised tag or person you swap for another in place: a click, Enter or Space opens a small Combobox in a popover from the words, with every choice under it at once; the pick rewrites the words, one commit per pick. At rest it is the Mark exactly.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/mark-pick.md. SwiftUI: MetalMarkPick in the MetalUI Swift package.
